description: Signed index prices for up to 100 crypto assets in ONE call — each row carries its own signature you can verify individually with pulse_verify_print, offline, with no network call, not just the batch as a whole. Use this instead of looping pulse_signed_price: it is one request against the rate limit and every observation still carries its own signature, grade, venue count and interval. Symbols Pulse does not serve come back named in not_served rather than silently missing. Requires a Pulse API key via _apiKey. Example: pulse_signed_batch({ symbols: ["BTC", "ETH", "SOL"] }).

_apiKey.description: Pulse Verity API key. Free and self-serve at https://thepulse.markets/developers (60 req/min, 25,000/month, no card).

symbols.description: Up to 100 tickers. A comma-separated string is also accepted.

name: pulse_signed_batch

each_row_signed.description: Reminder each observation is independently verifiable

not_served.description: Symbols requested but absent from Pulse's response

not_served_note.description: Explains why not_served exists and how to read it, when at least one requested symbol got no print.

observations.description: One signed print per served symbol, each independently verifiable

at.description: Observation timestamp, 4th field of the canonical string

confidence.description: Pulse's confidence score for this observation

dispersionBps.description: Spread across venues in basis points

grade.description: consensus/blended/indicative, 5th field of the canonical string

grade_note.description: Plain-English meaning of grade and whether it is settleable

kid.description: Key id selecting which public key verifies this row's signature

price.description: Price as a float; priceText is what was actually signed

priceText.description: Price exactly as served, 3rd field of the canonical string

sig.description: Signing scheme tag, 1st field of the canonical string (pulse-index-v1)

signature.description: Base64 ECDSA P-256 signature over this row's canonical string

symbol.description: Asset ticker, 2nd field of this row's canonical string

returned.description: Count of symbols Pulse actually served

title: Pulse Signed Batch
